rv.q: Close is the major reason to see Trevor Nunn's production of Andrew Lloyd Webber's latest, an extravaganza that turns Billy Wilder's acidic movie classic about the Hollywood dream-machine into a sort of theme-park operetta noir.
Sunset Boulevard, however, is little more than an expensive explosion of kitsch, the denigration of a movie classic.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Musical

cn.t: Close delivers a daring, over-the-top performance in a production elevated by fabulous scenery, but the musical itself disappoints as a toothless romantic take on Hollywood's dark tale.

vs.sum: A modern, well-equipped theater with clean sightlines from most sections. The contemporary design lacks the ornate character of older Broadway houses but delivers reliable sound and adequate comfort. Home to The Lion King since 2006.

acc.note: Dedicated elevator to Orchestra and Mezzanine. 12 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra, 2 in Mezzanine. Hearing loop installed.
